BiblicalUsage: Philonexia is hospitality, the love of strangers, and it appears twice. Paul tells the Romans to distribute to the necessity of saints and to be given to hospitality, and the writer to the Hebrews says not to forget to entertain strangers, for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hospitality is the gospel practised at the door: the stranger I entertain may be an angel, and the saint I feed is Christ Himself.
